events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas, tragically passing away days later.

angles.name: Tribute to an icon
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur today, 30 years since his untimely passing. His music and message continue to resonate.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1970, legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix died in London at the age of 27.

angles.name: Remembering a legend
angles.copy: 56 years since we lost a true guitar hero. Jimi Hendrix's legacy continues to inspire generations.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in the UK on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years of 'Abbey Road'! The Beatles' final recorded album gave us some timeless tracks and that legendary zebra crossing cover. Which is your favourite?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking with The Pretenders and inspiring us all.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album Turns 55
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon released the iconic 'Imagine' album. Its message of peace and unity is as powerful today as it was in 1971.

events.title: First iPod Launched
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple introduced the very first iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod's 25th Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember this? 25 years ago today, the original iPod dropped and changed everything. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the film franchise, marking the release date of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Happy James Bond Day
angles.copy: Grab a martini (shaken, not stirred) – it's James Bond Day! Celebrating 64 years since 'Dr. No' first hit screens. Who's your favourite 007?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks the birthday of The Beatles legend, John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music still speaks to us all.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius, John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British icon.

events.title: White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Turns 58
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unveiled 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that still sparks debate. What's your standout track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie Mercury
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. Forever a legend.

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in the UK on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turns 61
angles.copy: 61 years of 'Rubber Soul'! The Beatles' album that marked a significant shift in their sound. An absolute classic.
